archetypes.name: completeness
archetypes.rationale: This is the third recurrence of a default-order flip; a sweep for any remaining stale cursor-first references outside the three diff files guards against partial revert.
archetypes.prompt_body: Grep the repository for any remaining references to the old cursor-first ordering (e.g. 'cursor.*codex.*claude', 'cursor-first', or variants of 'cursor→codex') in files outside the three touched by this diff (python/bootstrap.py, python/test_bootstrap.py, skills/implement/SKILL.md). Verify that the SKILL.md 'phase_coder_select' authority paragraph and every other prose description of the implicit implementer waterfall is now internally consistent — no paragraph should still contradict the restored codex→cursor→claude order. Cross-check each hit against the plan's 'Do NOT touch' list to confirm intentional non-default orderings (review-fix applier, scout waterfall) are correctly left alone. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
